summary: Multi-user Roles and Candidate Assignments feature testing completed successfully. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for Users page, Candidate Detail page with assignments, and permission restrictions for recruiters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-user roles and candidate assignments feature verified. Key validations: 1) Admin can list/create users, recruiters get 403. 2) GET /users/me returns can_manage_users and can_assign_candidates flags. 3) Admin can assign/unassign candidates, recruiters cannot. 4) GET /candidates/{id}/can-edit returns correct permissions. 5) Frontend Users page shows user list with roles, status, stats. 6) Candidate detail shows assignment section. 7) Recruiter sees 'Modo solo lectura' banner for unassigned candidates. 8) Usuarios link hidden from recruiter sidebar.

TestUserManagement.test_admin_can_list_users: PASS - Admin listed 8 users, no password_hash exposed
TestUserManagement.test_get_current_user_with_permissions: PASS - Admin has can_manage_users=true, recruiter has false

users_page.description: Users page shows user list with roles (Recruiter, Admin, Super Admin), status badges, candidates assigned count, jobs created count, last login dates, and 'Nuevo Usuario' button

candidate_detail_page.description: Candidate detail shows Asignaciones section with assigned recruiters, Asignar button for admin, Editar button

assignment_dialog.description: Assignment dialog shows recruiter dropdown, notes field, Cancel and Asignar buttons

recruiter_permission_restriction.description: Recruiter sees 'Modo solo lectura' banner, Edit button disabled, no Assign button visible

recruiter_sidebar.description: Usuarios link NOT visible for recruiter (correctly hidden)
